responsibility: Maps user-visible S/390 target options declared in `s390.opt` to the corresponding anchors in GCC’s generated manual. This autogenerated companion file is consumed by GCC’s option/documentation machinery so diagnostics, help output, or generated docs can attach stable `UrlSuffix` references for System z switches such as `-march`, `-mtune`, ABI-selection, vector, HTM, stack, and profiling-related options; entries omitted here indicate options with no matching manual anchor.
